key_points: Congress Asset Management bought 1,917 DE shares; Wealth Enhancement Trust sold 2,007 shares (small offsetting trades).
DE shares fell ~3.8% on Oct 7 amid broader sector slump.
FTC and USDA launched inquiry into farm equipment market practices, raising antitrust/regulatory risk.
No earnings release, guidance change, or material corporate news in headlines.
Regulatory overhang could affect sentiment and valuation over weeks to months.
